name: Sisters
source:
After leaving her first high profile fashion show, Serena gets a phone call from her sister, Anne, who is curious about it went. 

[from [url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/sisters]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞雷娜剛結束自己第一次備受矚目的時裝秀，姊妹安妮便打來電話，想知道秀場上一切是否順利。
